[FYI] the PROVIDER should offer the following tests:
**HIV serology** – HIV negative MSM with >1 partner since the last check
**RPR –** MSM with multiple partners and intermittent condom use should be screened every 3-6 months
**Urethral and Pharyngeal Chlamydia / gonorrhea** – insertive anal and oral sex (urethral), receptive oral sex (pharyngeal). Rectal screening is not required if patient had prior negative testing and does not engage in receptive anal sex.
